answer_1.quote: We use prompts from best-seller books and LeetCode coding problems and measure memorization across large language models.
answer_1.outputs: Verbatim reconstructions of copyrighted texts or LeetCode problem descriptions

answer_2.quote: The evaluation is performed by measuring the number of words in Longest Common Subsequence (LCS length) between the generated text and the gold text. We also provide results for Levenshtein Distance in the Appendix.
